user.title: Connect SolarBright inverter
user.description: Enter the IP address or host name of the inverter. It must be switched on (in daylight) to be added.

reconfigure.title: Change inverter address
reconfigure.description: Enter the new IP address or host name of this inverter.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the inverter. Check the address, and that the inverter is on (it sleeps when there is no sun).
error.invalid_response: The device answered, but not like a SolarBright inverter.

abort.already_configured: This inverter is already configured. Its address has been updated.
abort.wrong_device: This address belongs to a different inverter than the one being changed.

data_description.skip_night: Do not read while the sun is below the horizon. Power is reported as 0 W at night.
